info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/patina/material
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/patina/material queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate a complete PBR material from a text prompt.

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable the safety checker for generated images.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

maps.description: Which PBR maps to predict. Deselect all to skip PBR estimation entirely. Defaults to all five.
maps.title: Maps

output_format.description: Output image format for textures and PBR maps.
output_format.title: Output Format

num_images.description: Number of texture images to generate.
num_images.title: Number of Images

enable_prompt_expansion.description: Expand prompt with an LLM for richer detail. Adds ~0.0025 credits.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the material/texture to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

mask_url.title: Mask URL
mask_url.description: URL of a mask image for inpainting. White regions are regenerated, black regions are preserved. Requires image_url.

num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps for texture generation.
num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of an input image for image-to-image or inpainting. When provided without mask_url, performs image-to-image; with mask_url, performs inpainting.

strength.description: How much to transform the input image. Only used when image_url is provided.
strength.title: Strength

upscale_factor.description: Upscale factor for predicted PBR maps via SeedVR seamless upscaling. 0 = no upscaling, 2 = 2× resolution, 4 = 4× resolution. The base texture image is not upscaled.
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor

prompt.description: The prompt used for texture generation (possibly expanded).
prompt.title: Prompt

images.description: Generated tileable texture image(s) from z-image and predicted PBR material maps from PATINA.
images.title: Images

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

map_type.description: Which PBR map this image represents.
map_type.title: Map Type

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
